summary: The agent failed because it wrote the workbook from scratch instead of using the existing skeleton script, introducing the self-referencing Ending Balance bug (=B10+C10-D10 instead of =B9+C9-D9). This is the #1 documented anti-pattern. The patch strengthens the skeleton requirement, adds commission asset rollforward as a recognized variant, and makes the self-referencing bug more prominent with a concrete detection rule.
